message.content:
Below is a concise “calendar‑style” rundown of **Canadian federal/public holidays** that produced *long weekends* during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” here means a holiday that either lands on a weekday adjacent to a natural weekend—Thursday, Friday, Monday—or is officially observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Date | Holiday | Province(s) observing | Why it made a long weekend |
|------|---------|-----------------------|----------------------------|
| **Jan 01 – 02** | New Year’s Day (Observed Jan 02) | All provinces | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday → observed Monday, giving a 3‑day stretch (Sat 12 Dec 2022 / Sun 1 Jan 2023 / Mon 2 Jan 2023). |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, PEI) | Those provinces | Falls on Monday → the preceding weekend (Sat 18 Feb 2023 / Sun 19 Feb 2023) plus the holiday makes a 3‑day break. |
| **Apr 07** | Good Friday | All provinces | Good Friday is Friday → the following weekend (Sat 08 Apr 2023 / Sun 09 Apr 2023) forms a 3‑day block. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces | Occurs on Monday → again a 3‑day stretch (Sat 20 May 2023 / Sun 21 May 2023). |
| **Jul 03** *(obs.*) | Canada Day (Obs. on Mon Jul 03 because Canada Day fell on Saturday) | All provinces | Official holiday on Monday adds to the weekend that began on Saturday, July 01. |
| **Sep 04** | Labour Day | All provinces | Labour Day is always on the first Monday of September → a classic long weekend. |
| **Oct 09** | Thanksgiving | All provinces | First Monday of October → another standard long weekend. |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Most provinces (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NL, NS, PEI); not a statutory holiday in NT, NU, YT | Falls on Thursday → the subsequent weekend (Sat 13 Nov 2023 / Sun 14 Nov 2023) completes a 3‑day span. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | All provinces | Christmas Day landed on Monday → the weekend immediately precedes it (Sat 23 Dec 2023 / Sun 24 Dec 2023). |

### Quick Reference Summary

```
• Jan 1–2   : New Year’s Day (All)
• Feb 20    : Family Day (most provinces)
• Apr 7     : Good Friday (All)
• May 22    : Victoria Day (All)
• Jul 3     : Canada Day (all, obs.)
• Sep 4     : Labour Day (All)
• Oct 9     : Thanksgiving (All)
• Nov 11    : Remembrance Day (majority)
• Dec 25    : Christmas Day (All)
```

> **Note:** Provincial holidays that fall outside the above list (e.g., Natal Day in BC, Heritage Days in various provinces, etc.) were omitted because the request specified *national* long weekends.  

These entries cover every federally recognized holiday that generated a multi‑day vacation period across Canada in 2023. Feel free to plug them directly into your holiday‑planning app!
